scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build:engine-types && npm run generate:engine-files && concurrently "npm run build:js" "npm run build:types"
scripts.build:dev: npm run copy:editor-assets && npm run build:shoelace && npm run generate:engine-files && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/main.js --target=es2022 --platform=browser --minify --sourcemap --loader:.png=dataurl --watch
scripts.build:js: npm run copy:editor-assets && npm run build:shoelace && npm run generate:engine-files && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/main.js --target=es2022 --platform=browser --minify --sourcemap --loader:.png=dataurl --define:FLINT_ESBUILD_MODULE_URL='"./vendor/esbuild/browser.min.js"' --define:FLINT_ESBUILD_WASM_URL='"./dist/vendor/esbuild/esbuild.wasm"' && node scripts/build-sw.mjs --mode default --out service-worker.js
scripts.build:cdn: npm run build:engine-types && npm run build:cdn:site && npm run build:js && node scripts/build-sw.mjs --mode cdn --out cdn/service-worker.js && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=cdn/dist/main.js --target=es2022 --platform=browser --minify --sourcemap --loader:.png=dataurl --define:FLINT_ESBUILD_MODULE_URL='"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/esbuild-wasm@0.28.1/esm/browser.min.js"' --define:FLINT_ESBUILD_WASM_URL='"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/esbuild-wasm@0.28.1/esbuild.wasm"'
